# About Culture Things
> Local-led private and small-group day tours from Lisbon, Portugal. Tours are available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

## Booking facts
- Official website: https://aboutculturethings.com/web/
- Prices are published in EUR; USD display prices are indicative and payment is charged in EUR.
- Free cancellation at least 48 hours before departure.
- Monument tickets and meals are excluded unless expressly stated.
- Private tours include hotel pickup in Lisbon, Sintra or Cascais.
- The shared Sintra tour meets at Hard Rock Cafe Lisboa.

## Tours
- Sintra, Pena, Cabo da Roca & Cascais small group — 8–9 hours — €99/person — minimum 3, maximum 6.
- Private Sintra Complete — 8–9 hours — €449/group — 1–6 guests.
- Private Fátima, Nazaré & Óbidos — 9–10 hours — €549/group — 1–6 guests.
- Private Évora Heritage & Wine — 8–9 hours — €569/group — Chapel of Bones, Roman Temple, lunch in Évora and Alentejo wine tasting.
